title: Easier TFMG Concrete coloring
description: Datapack making coloured concrete from Create: The Factory Must Grow craftable
body:
![Recipes added by the mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/023aa34b9848c0c3a5f4e0bf7d819fa03c054bda.png)

A simple datapack that makes colored concrete from Create: The Factory Must Grow craftable, instead of having to deploy dye on every single block

Yes, you can use this datapack in modpacks if you so desire.
